description: Figures of one statement for one company from its latest snapshot, filtered by period and item. Every row gives its period with start and end dates, whether each value is reported or derived, and the source document ids of its values; item units are in `items`, and the answer names its snapshot for the citation.

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

compact.description: true for the rows with their units only, without the conventions, item definitions and citation format

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple or mizuho

frequency.description: for income_statement and cash_flow (default annual); other statements have one frequency

from.description: first period: a fiscal year (2024), a fiscal quarter (FY2024 Q2) or an ISO date

items.description: item keys to keep, for example ["revenue", "net_income"]; leave empty for all

limit.description: maximum rows, latest first kept (default 40, at most 60)

statement.description: income_statement, balance_sheet and cash_flow; Mizuho also has capital, npl, shares and annual_highlights

to.description: last period, in the same forms

name: get_statement
title: Get a financial statement
